# Wind Turbine (WindTurbine)

> **Class**: `WindTurbine` | **Module**: `energysim.models.renewables` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Wind Turbine with multi-point power curve, air density correction and rotor lag.

Air density is corrected on the *wind speed*: the power curve (defined at
standard density 1.225 kg/m3) is evaluated at
``v_eff = v * (rho / rho0) ** (1/3)``, so the rated plateau is not derated
at winds well above rated speed. Density follows the ideal gas law with
pressure from the barometric formula at ``altitude_m``. Cut-out is applied
on the actual wind speed. A first-order lag models rotor/pitch inertia.

Validity: hub-height wind 0-30 m/s, T_amb -30..45 C, altitude 0-3000 m; no
wake, turbulence, icing or yaw-misalignment effects.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'WindTurbine'` | - | - |
| `p_rated_mw` | `float` | `3.0` | MW | Rated electrical output power in MW. |
| `cut_in_speed_ms` | `float` | `3.0` | m/s | Cut-in wind speed in m/s. |
| `rated_speed_ms` | `float` | `11.5` | m/s | Rated wind speed in m/s. |
| `cut_out_speed_ms` | `float` | `25.0` | m/s | Cut-out wind speed in m/s. |
| `rotor_time_constant_sec` | `float` | `4.0` | s | 1st-order rotor inertia acceleration/pitch lag time constant. |
| `power_curve` | `Optional[Curve1D]` | `None` | - | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |
| `altitude_m` | `float` | `0.0` | m | Site altitude above sea level in metres (barometric pressure correction). |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `v_wind` | m/s | - |
| `T_amb` | degC | - |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_actual` | MW | Net active power delivered to the collector substation |

## Validity and notes

Validity: hub-height wind 0-30 m/s, T_amb -30..45 C, altitude 0-3000 m; no
wake, turbulence, icing or yaw-misalignment effects.

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import WindTurbine

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('windturbine', model=WindTurbine(), outputs=['P_actual'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['windturbine'].tail(2))
```
